Script.Name: IRPMTotalModMinMaxISOBOPCW
Script.Title: IRPM Total Modification and Minimum Maximum
Script.Comment: This script may be used by other lines of business, but could contain different page fields, pick list values as well as minimum and maximum credits/debits by line and/or by state within a specific line. Six table columns defined in the BOPIRPM database table must be totaled and displayed in BOPIRPM.TotalModificationPct. The table column names are BuildingFeaturesPct, LocationPct, ManagementPct, PremisesEquipmentPct, EmployeesPct and ProtectionPct. Arizona is the first state to test. The BOPIRPM.TotalModificationPct cannot be > -25% or > 25%. When the TotalModificationPct exceeds the amount, display the message "The total credit/debit cannot exceed 25%." Do not reset page field values to 0% when the TotalModificationPct exceeds 25%.

Script.Name: SetClassOptLimitsISOBOPCW
Script.Title: Set Accounts Receivable & Valuable Papers Limits
Script.Comment: If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit = "0" AND BOPClassification.FunctlBusnPrsnlPropValtnApply = "No", then set BOPClassificationAccountsReceivableCoverage.Limit AND BOPClassificationValuablePapersCoverage.Limit to "0". If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit = "0" AND BOPClassification.FunctlBusnPrsnlPropValtnApply = "Yes" AND BOPClassificationAccountsReceivableCoverage.Limit < "10000", then set field to "10000". If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit = "0" AND BOPClassification.FunctlBusnPrsnlPropValtnApply = "Yes" AND BOPClassificationValuablePapersCoverage.Limit < "10000", then set field to "10000". If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit = "0" AND BOPClassification.FunctlBusnPrsnlPropValtnApply = "Yes" AND BOPClassificationAccountsReceivableCoverage.Limit >= "10000", do not change field value. If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit = "0" AND BOPClassification.FunctlBusnPrsnlPropValtnApply = "Yes" AND BOPClassificationValuablePapersCoverage.Limit >= "10000", do not change field value. If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit > "0" AND BOPClassificationAccountsReceivableCoverage.Limit < "10000", then set field to "10000". If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit > "0" AND BOPClassificationValuablePapersCoverage.Limit < "10000", then set field to "10000". If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit > "0" AND BOPClassificationAccountsReceivableCoverage.Limit >= "10000", do not change field value. If BOPClassification.BusnPrsnlPropLimit > "0" AND BOPClassificationValuablePapersCoverage.Limit >= "10000", do not change field value.

Script.Name: SetOrdinanceLawCov3LimitISOBOPCW
Script.Title: Set Ordinance Or Law Coverage 3 Limit
Script.Comment: If BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov.Coverage = "Coverage 1 Only", "Coverage 3 Only", "Coverages 1 and 2" OR "Coverages 1, 2 and 3", then set BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov3Coverage.Limit = "10000" if BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov3Coverage.Limit < "10000". If BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov.Coverage = "Coverage 1 with Coverages 2 and 3 Combined", then set BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov2And3Coverage.Limit = "10000" if BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov2And3Coverage.Limit < "10000". If BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov.Coverage <> "Coverages 1 and 2" OR "Coverages 1, 2 and3", then set BOPOrdinanceOrLawCov2Coverage.Limit = "0".
